findings.finding: The acceptance conjunction is syntactically explicit and the negative cases are classified without universal information-loss inference.
The revised checker constructs projected value records and typed witness records with context, source, target, and relation provenance; this is supported within the finite fixture model.

The revised checker validates ordered history event payloads and witness identity linkage, but the event schema remains a finite model contract rather than an independently established semantics of history.

Pi_D,C construction maps fixture-supplied projected values into typed records; the projection function remains parameterized by fixture supplied definedness and values, so arbitrary projection semantics are not established.
A positive subthreshold fixture is now rejected as expected, but the threshold remains the stipulated constant 1.0 and is not derived or independently validated.
